localeAndSlugRules: Spanish public paths are unprefixed and must not move; English public paths are under /en.
The 23 proposed route ids and their ES/EN slugs are frozen by the MC-15 data contract; no extra route may be added.
Dynamic slugs are the same string in both locales so the entity identity stays stable.
The productDocumentation slug is the lowercase family id (nav, hub, ais, pilot, sense, watch, display, weather, fleet); an edition id must never appear in a URL.
No proposed slug may collide with a current route, a legacy redirect or an admin surface.

pageVsSkuIdentity.rule: A page represents a family, a bundle, a tool, a corporate index or a documentation entity. A page never represents one purchasable edition.
The edition id is the stable SKU identity candidate. No separate merchant SKU code exists yet and none may be invented by MC-16.
An entitlement is neither a page nor a SKU; it is a licensed capability reference attached to a SKU or bundle.

pageVsSkuRules: One family page exposes zero or more editions; the page is indexable independently of edition merchantability, but only after its gates close.
No page may be created per edition, per price, per stock state or per locale variant beyond the ES/EN pair.
A bundle page represents a bundle entity, not a SKU; its reference configuration is a composition of edition ids.
PILOT-PRO is an INSTALLATION_PACKAGE, not a SKU and not a page; it may only appear as a quoted scope.
The productDocumentation entity is keyed by family id, never by edition id.
Page identity, SKU identity and entitlement identity must remain separate foreign keys in any future commerce model.

commercialGateSummary.mc16Rule: MC-16 must treat every gate as open. No gate may be inferred CLOSED from a test pass, a build, a document draft, an internal decision or the existence of this handoff.

seoPublicationEligibility.policy: Retain existing indexed URLs and canonical/hreflang behaviour; MC-15 does not change them.

seoPublicationEligibility.rule: No MAREA brand string in any title, description, Open Graph or Twitter card until trademark clearance and a public-use decision exist.
No availability, stock, price, delivery, certification or performance wording in metadata.
Canonical is self-referencing per indexable page; hreflang groups are reciprocal; x-default remains home-only.
No alternate is emitted for an untranslated page.
A page blocked by any gate is never added to the sitemap, even if the route resolves locally.

structuredDataRestrictions.restriction: Must not assert registered trademark status; Open Marine must not be used as a Product brand until the IPR-13/IPR-15 items close.
BLOCKED until GATE-LEGAL-ENTITY supplies verified identity.

price_cents and stock from the admin model may never be emitted as an offer while GATE-PRICING is open.

structuredDataPolicyOwner: MC-15 D10 structured-data governance owns the final schema policy; MC-16 must consume D10 plus this restriction list and must not expand it.

priceAndStockProvenance.value: price_cents, single integer in cents; no VAT rate, tax base or territory field exists.
stock, admin-entered integer; no fulfilment, warehouse or reservation record exists.
Price and stock are re-read server-side; client changes are rejected.
Derived directly from admin price and stock; this is a defect (WEB-014).

priceAndStockRequirements: Store price provenance (approved price list reference, VAT basis, territory, currency, approval record) separately from any hypothesis value.
Store stock provenance (fulfilment source, reservation record, timestamp) separately from any admin-entered integer.
Never derive a public offer, structured-data node or checkout amount from a HYPOTHESIS_UNAPPROVED price.
Keep server-authoritative validation; reject any client-supplied price or stock.
Keep the sample catalogue non-sale and noindex-separated from the real catalogue.

entitlementSummary.subscriptionIsolationRule: Local safety-relevant function must never depend on subscription state; an expired entitlement never disables steering, local alarms or local measurement.
entitlementSummary.weatherEntitlementRule: WEATHER uses one entitlement ledger; NAV Pro may include WEATHER Standard-equivalent read where provider rights allow; the same entitlement is never billed twice and cancelling NAV never deletes user-owned WEATHER records.
mc16Requirements: Model entitlement identity separately from SKU identity and from page identity.
Do not implement billing, renewal, proration or dunning in MC-16; the handoff only records the contract references.
Enforce the single WEATHER entitlement ledger and prohibit double billing.
Enforce subscription isolation: local safety-relevant functions never depend on entitlement state.

currentCommerceIntegrationRisks.description: The only offer source is the admin product row (price_cents, stock, active); activating a row would publish an unapproved price and stock.
currentCommerceIntegrationRisks.mc16Handling: Separate approved offer records from admin drafts; never derive a public offer from an admin row.

currentCommerceIntegrationRisks.description: Product/Offer JSON-LD is derived directly from admin price and stock with the Open Marine brand.
currentCommerceIntegrationRisks.mc16Handling: Expose structured-data eligibility as a derived, gate-controlled flag; default false.

currentCommerceIntegrationRisks.description: The order email says the order is received as a thank-you before seller acceptance, conflating acknowledgement and contract conclusion.
currentCommerceIntegrationRisks.mc16Handling: Model order acknowledgement, seller acceptance and payment as separate states.

currentCommerceIntegrationRisks.description: Registration consent is displayed but not submitted or stored, so no consent evidence exists.
currentCommerceIntegrationRisks.mc16Handling: Store policy version, timestamp, source and lawful basis before account creation.

currentCommerceIntegrationRisks.description: Shipping and installation costs are excluded from the cart total and confirmed later.
currentCommerceIntegrationRisks.mc16Handling: Model delivery/installation cost components and expose the final payable amount before the order.

currentCommerceIntegrationRisks.description: The single checkout checkbox bundles privacy acknowledgement with contractual acceptance and no model withdrawal form is shown.
currentCommerceIntegrationRisks.mc16Handling: Separate consent records; include pre-contract withdrawal information.

currentCommerceIntegrationRisks.description: Subscription and entitlement references exist only as hypotheses; no ledger, billing or renewal implementation exists.
currentCommerceIntegrationRisks.mc16Handling: Model entitlement references only; do not implement billing.

currentCommerceIntegrationRisks.description: The sample catalogue is non-sale and noindex; the separation must survive any commerce refactor.
currentCommerceIntegrationRisks.mc16Handling: Preserve the non-sale, noindex and no-hreflang behaviour for sample SKUs.

currentCommerceIntegrationRisks.description: Google Identity Services script is not disclosed in the cookie information.
currentCommerceIntegrationRisks.mc16Handling: Disclose the integration before any auth-dependent commerce flow is enabled.

currentCommerceIntegrationRisks.description: Seller legal identity is empty and the public legal notice admits it is pending.
currentCommerceIntegrationRisks.mc16Handling: Do not model a seller, merchant of record or invoice issuer until verified identity exists.
